name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana
description: Central income-support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families. Confirm the current benefit amount, installment status, and exclusion rules on the official portal.
description_mr: पात्र जमीनधारक शेतकरी कुटुंबांसाठी केंद्र सरकारची आर्थिक सहाय्य योजना. सध्याची लाभरक्कम, हप्त्यांची स्थिती आणि अपात्रता नियम अधिकृत पोर्टलवर तपासा.
description_hi: पात्र भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों के लिए केंद्र सरकार की आय-सहायता योजना। मौजूदा लाभ राशि, किस्त की स्थिति और अपवर्जन नियम आधिकारिक पोर्टल पर जांचें।
target_beneficiaries: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names (subject to exclusion criteria).
eligibility_criteria: Must own cultivable agricultural land in applicant's name with valid 7/12 extract or Land Records.
Aadhaar card must be linked to bank account with active e-KYC completed.
Excluded: Institutional landholders, serving/retired government employees, income tax payees, and constitutional post holders.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card
7/12 Extract (७/१२ उतारा) / 8-A (८-अ उतारा)
Aadhaar-seeded Bank Account Passbook
Active Mobile number linked to Aadhaar
benefits: Income support is transferred to eligible beneficiaries. Confirm current amounts and installment status on the official portal.
benefits_mr: पात्र लाभार्थ्यांना आर्थिक सहाय्य दिले जाते. सध्याची रक्कम आणि हप्त्यांची स्थिती अधिकृत पोर्टलवर तपासा.
benefits_hi: पात्र लाभार्थियों को आय-सहायता दी जाती है। मौजूदा राशि और किस्त की स्थिति आधिकारिक पोर्टल पर जांचें।
application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) or an authorized Common Service Centre (CSC).
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' under Farmers Corner.
Enter the requested registration details and select your actual state and district.
Fill land record details (Survey/Gat number, Khata number, Area) and complete Aadhaar OTP e-KYC.

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi Yojana (Maharashtra)
description: Maharashtra supplementary income-support scheme listed for eligible PM-KISAN beneficiaries. Confirm current enrollment, benefit amount, and installment status with the state portal.
description_mr: पात्र पीएम-किसान लाभार्थ्यांसाठी महाराष्ट्राची पूरक आर्थिक सहाय्य योजना. सध्याची नोंदणी, लाभरक्कम आणि हप्त्यांची स्थिती राज्याच्या पोर्टलवर तपासा.
description_hi: पात्र PM-KISAN लाभार्थियों के लिए महाराष्ट्र की पूरक आय-सहायता योजना। मौजूदा पंजीकरण, लाभ राशि और किस्त की स्थिति राज्य पोर्टल पर जांचें।
target_beneficiaries: Farmers of Maharashtra already approved and receiving benefits under the Central PM-KISAN scheme.
eligibility_criteria: Must be a resident of Maharashtra with agricultural land registered in the state.
Must be an active, verified beneficiary receiving PM-KISAN installments.
Land record (7/12) and Bank Aadhaar seeding must be in verified status on PM-KISAN portal.
required_documents: PM-KISAN Registration ID
Aadhaar Card with biometric e-KYC
Maharashtra 7/12 Extract with updated Land Record
Bank Account details linked with NPCI
benefits: Supplementary income support may be available to eligible beneficiaries. Confirm the current amount and payment schedule with the state portal.
benefits_mr: पात्र लाभार्थ्यांना पूरक आर्थिक सहाय्य मिळू शकते. सध्याची रक्कम आणि देयक वेळापत्रक राज्याच्या पोर्टलवर तपासा.
benefits_hi: पात्र लाभार्थियों को पूरक आय-सहायता मिल सकती है। मौजूदा राशि और भुगतान कार्यक्रम राज्य पोर्टल पर जांचें।
application_steps: Check the current eligibility and enrollment process on the Maharashtra Agriculture Department portal.
Verify beneficiary and installment status through the official state portal or an authorized service center.
Confirm current Aadhaar and bank-mapping requirements with the implementing office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
name_mr: प्रधानमंत्री पीक विमा योजना (१ रुपयात पीक विमा)
description: Government crop insurance for notified crops and areas. Coverage, farmer premium, enrollment windows, and claim conditions depend on the current season notification; check the official portal before applying.
description_mr: अधिसूचित पिके आणि क्षेत्रांसाठी शासकीय पीक विमा. संरक्षण, शेतकरी हप्ता, नोंदणीची मुदत आणि दावा अटी हंगामाच्या अधिसूचनेनुसार बदलतात; अर्ज करण्यापूर्वी अधिकृत पोर्टल तपासा.
description_hi: अधिसूचित फसलों और क्षेत्रों के लिए सरकारी फसल बीमा। कवरेज, किसान प्रीमियम, आवेदन अवधि और दावा शर्तें मौजूदा मौसम की अधिसूचना पर निर्भर हैं; आवेदन से पहले आधिकारिक पोर्टल देखें।
target_beneficiaries: All farmers growing notified crops in notified insurance units (both loanee and non-loanee farmers).
eligibility_criteria: Cultivating notified kharif/rabi crops on owned or tenant/sharecropper land.
Submit the land or sowing documents required by the current state and season notification before its deadline.
Report crop damage within the deadline and through the channel specified in the current policy.
required_documents: 7/12 Extract (७/१२ उतारा) and Sowing Certificate (पीक पेरा स्वयंघोषणा पत्र)
Aadhaar Card
Bank passbook copy showing IFSC and Account Number
Tenant agreement / Sowing declaration if tenant farmer
benefits: Coverage and claim terms depend on the notified crop, area, season, and current scheme rules. Confirm the applicable premium and coverage on the official portal.
benefits_mr: अधिसूचित पीक, क्षेत्र, हंगाम आणि चालू योजनेच्या नियमांनुसार संरक्षण व दावा अटी लागू होतात. लागू हप्ता आणि संरक्षण अधिकृत पोर्टलवर तपासा.
benefits_hi: अधिसूचित फसल, क्षेत्र, मौसम और मौजूदा योजना नियमों के अनुसार कवरेज व दावा शर्तें लागू होती हैं। लागू प्रीमियम और कवरेज आधिकारिक पोर्टल पर जांचें।
application_steps: Apply through PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in) or CSC / Aaple Sarkar Kendra within notified season deadline.
Select State: Maharashtra, Season (Kharif/Rabi), and select survey number from digitized 7/12.
Check the current season's premium, notification, enrollment deadline, and receipt requirements on the official portal before applying.

name: MahaDBT Micro Irrigation Subsidy (Drip & Sprinkler)
name_mr: महाडीबीटी सूक्ष्म सिंचन योजना (ठिबक व तुषार सिंचन अनुदान)
name_hi: महाडीबीटी सूक्ष्म सिंचाई योजना (ड्रिप और स्प्रिंकलर)
description: A Maharashtra portal listing for support toward micro-irrigation systems such as drip and sprinkler. Current component availability, subsidy rates, eligible costs, and category rules must be confirmed on the official portal.
description_mr: ठिबक व तुषार सिंचनासारख्या सूक्ष्म सिंचनासाठी महाराष्ट्र पोर्टलवरील सहाय्य योजना. सध्याची घटक उपलब्धता, अनुदान दर, पात्र खर्च आणि प्रवर्गाचे नियम अधिकृत पोर्टलवर तपासा.
description_hi: ड्रिप और स्प्रिंकलर जैसी सूक्ष्म सिंचाई के लिए महाराष्ट्र पोर्टल पर सहायता योजना। मौजूदा घटक उपलब्धता, सब्सिडी दर, पात्र लागत और श्रेणी नियम आधिकारिक पोर्टल पर जांचें।
target_beneficiaries: Farmers of Maharashtra having a perennial water source (well, borewell, canal, farm pond) and electricity connection.
eligibility_criteria: Check the current minimum land and component-specific requirements on the official portal.
Provide proof of an accepted water source if required by the current component.
Check current repeat-benefit restrictions for the same survey number.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card
7/12 Extract and 8-A Extract with water source entry
Caste Certificate (for SC/ST farmers to claim enhanced subsidy)
Authorized BIS/ISI standard equipment quotation from registered dealer
Electric bill / Water source proof
benefits: Assistance and subsidy rates depend on the active component and applicant details. Confirm the current amount and approval process on the official portal.
benefits_mr: सहाय्य आणि अनुदान दर चालू घटक व अर्जदाराच्या तपशीलांवर अवलंबून असतात. सध्याची रक्कम आणि मंजुरी प्रक्रिया अधिकृत पोर्टलवर तपासा.
benefits_hi: सहायता और सब्सिडी दर सक्रिय घटक और आवेदक के विवरण पर निर्भर करते हैं। मौजूदा राशि और मंजूरी प्रक्रिया आधिकारिक पोर्टल पर जांचें।
application_steps: Review current notices on the Maharashtra DBT portal; application routes for some components or locations may have changed.
Locate the currently available micro-irrigation component and read its eligibility notice.
Submit only the documents requested by the current application workflow.
Wait for written approval before purchasing or installing equipment; follow the portal's inspection and payment steps.

name: Magel Tyala Shettale / Farm Pond Scheme
description: A Maharashtra listing for farm-pond support. Current scheme availability, technical site conditions, assistance amount, and application process must be confirmed in the official notice.
description_mr: शेततळ्यासाठी महाराष्ट्रातील सहाय्य योजना. सध्याची योजना उपलब्धता, जागेच्या तांत्रिक अटी, सहाय्य रक्कम आणि अर्ज प्रक्रिया अधिकृत सूचनेत तपासा.
description_hi: खेत तालाब सहायता के लिए महाराष्ट्र की योजना सूची। मौजूदा उपलब्धता, तकनीकी स्थल शर्तें, सहायता राशि और आवेदन प्रक्रिया आधिकारिक सूचना में जांचें।
target_beneficiaries: Farmers who meet the land, site, and other conditions in the current official scheme notice.
eligibility_criteria: Check the current landholding and applicant conditions in the official notice.
The site may require technical assessment for water harvesting and construction feasibility.
Confirm current construction, lining, and inspection conditions with the implementing office.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card
7/12 and 8-A Extract
Site survey layout / Agriculture Assistant feasibility report
Bank Account details linked to Aadhaar
benefits: Assistance amount and eligibility depend on the current scheme notice and technical site assessment. Confirm details with the official portal or implementing office.
benefits_mr: सहाय्य रक्कम आणि पात्रता चालू योजनेची सूचना व जागेच्या तांत्रिक तपासणीवर अवलंबून असतात. अधिकृत पोर्टल किंवा अंमलबजावणी कार्यालयाकडून तपासा.
benefits_hi: सहायता राशि और पात्रता मौजूदा योजना सूचना तथा तकनीकी स्थल जांच पर निर्भर करती है। आधिकारिक पोर्टल या कार्यान्वयन कार्यालय से पुष्टि करें।
application_steps: Confirm whether this scheme is currently open and identify its official application portal.
Ask the implementing office which site documents, design, and technical assessment are required.
Obtain written approval before starting any construction.
Follow the current inspection and payment instructions in the official notice.
